captions.caption: A person dumps charcoal from a basket onto a pile.
Charcoal forms a pile near an earthen structure.
The person empties the basket and leaves.
Men work near a tall mud structure.
One man tends fire; another brings a tool.
A man enters from a background doorway.
Three men occupy the primitive shelter area.
A man uses a pole on the mud structure.
He positions the pole into a vertical shaft.
The man adjusts the pole inside the shaft.
He manipulates the pole within the furnace.
He lifts the pole while another man works.
The man packs the interior with the pole.
He moves the pole inside the mud chimney.
The man sets the pole aside.
He prepares a new tool for the structure.
Men stand by the structure with bamboo.
A man holds a bamboo tube vertically.
He aligns the tube with the mud shaft.
He prepares to insert bamboo into the structure.
The man holds the tube above the furnace.
He lowers the bamboo tube into the shaft.
He inserts a second tube into the other shaft.
Bamboo tubes are positioned inside the shafts.
The man adjusts the bamboo tubes' placement.
He centers the tubes in the openings.
Bamboo tubes are seen nested in the mud.
The man lifts a bamboo tube slightly.
He repositions the tube back into the shaft.
Men continue working on the primitive setup.
One man works; another tends the fire.
A man stirs the fire in the oven.
The foreground man prepares to work on shafts.
He pushes a stick into the bamboo tubes.
He gives a thumbs up while holding the stick.
The man packs the bamboo's contents with a stick.
He moves the stick up and down rhythmically.
The man works on the second tube with a stick.
He continues the packing motion in the structure.
Both men focus on their respective tasks.
The man continues packing material with a stick.
Two men pack material into the mud shafts.
They move the sticks in unison.
Rhythmic packing continues to stabilize contents.
They compact material inside the chambers.
Men maintain steady motion with packing tools.
They finish packing and prepare for next steps.
One man packs; another reaches for a tool.
They use a horizontal stick for stabilization.
A man works on top of the mud shafts.
He applies more mud to the structure's top.
The man continues shaping the mud furnace top.
He refines the mud surface with a stick.
Men work together to smooth the mud shafts.
They shape and reinforce the upper furnace.
One man adds mud; the other smooths it.
They detail the top of the vertical shafts.
The man levels mud with a small wood piece.
They continue refining the primitive construction.
Men finish building the current mud structure stage.
